text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous☆
Would anyone like some marvelousness?★

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Would you care for some marvelousness?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Marvelous☆
Care for the most marvelous Marvelous around★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I ran into Marvelous Sunday and
Ikuno Dictus shouting strange things.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous☆
I'm handing out marvelousness, which everyone loves!
Would anyone like some marvelousness?★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You sound just like the Little Match Girl,
but...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Marvelous-san invited me.
She said she wants to spread surprise and happiness
around the academy. I thought it was a noble cause,
so I decided to help out.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, marvelous☆
Ikuno, you understand marvelous best of all★

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Hey! What do you think you're doing there?!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
I heard rumors that a strange student is walking around saying weird things!
Stop these incomprehensible activities at once!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Teacher! Marvelous!
It's marvelous☆
This world needs more Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What are you saying...!?
Just stop these suspicious activities at once!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No, Professor.
This is by no means a suspicious activity.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Think of it as community service.
She is simply trying to bring happiness, wonder, and joy to everyone through 'surprise.'"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing suspicious about those principles,
and it seems to be an honorable undertaking.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Mmhâ¦â¦
Howeverâ¦â¦ are you not plotting something sinister?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There is no two-faced nature to Marvelous-san.
She is simply sharing what she genuinely believes to be wonderful with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There is no hidden motive whatsoever.
The proof is that she asks for nothing
in return for these activities.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Mmh, grr...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Ikuno!
You truly are Marvelous☆
The absolute most Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah! You're right☆
Let's do something Marvelous for real★
Trainer, what kind of Marvelous would you like!?
choice_data_list: I've been watching my calories lately...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Whoa☆ You look pretty desperate!?
Here I go, then!
Healing Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Marvelous Sunday
struck a match.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Wha...!? What is it!?

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof woof!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow.

text_block_list.name: Sheep
text_block_list.text: Baaahhh.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ho, this is so very fluffy.
Hehe, come here, doggies and kitties.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ikuno Dictus had already adapted.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Uwooooh! So fluffy...!
The fluffiness is soothing my souuuul...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah~☆ I totally get it!
Here we go then!
Marvelous Full Belly★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Marvelous Sunday
struck a match.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: Wha...!? What is it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A lavish feast was laid out before us.
Turkey, carrot hamburg steak, gratin, and
cake. Every single dish looked delicious.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Ho, what a truly magnificent feast.
The aroma is lovely, and the flavor is exquisite.
Pure bliss in every bite.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The dessert is delicious too.
I would love to recommend this to McQueen-san as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Ikuno Dictus had already adapted.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, it's so good! Every single bite is way too delicious!
I-Is it really okay for me to eat this
without worrying about calories...?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
How was it? ☆
How was your Little Match Girl Marvelous experience? ★

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text: M-Marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Aha☆ Yay!
Looks like everyone's fallen in love with Marvelous★

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: And with that, the case is closed.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOAAAAAAHHHHH☆
Marvelously spectaaaculaaaar...★

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I feel like I might have dabbled in something outrageous, but I was able to spend a fulfilling day.
